Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your Day As an AI/ML Engineer in the Applied AI Solutions team, you will use the range of statistical, machine learning and LLM techniques, tools, models and agents (???AI) to enable the companys digital finance operations by automation. You will be a key contributor to Siemens Energy finance center of excellence for applied AI and automation. Youll work closely with solution architects, product managers, other data and AI engineers and finance experts/stakeholders to prototype, build and test scalable, production-ready AI solutions. Your day will involve deep thinking, coding and designing time, including involve Finance stakeholder interactions, experimentation, technique and algorithm selection, model training or querying, accuracy evaluations, or integration of AI into digital finance platforms.How Youll Make an Impact Development and deployment of AI-driven solutions to address business challenges such as forecasting, anomaly detection, and document classificationDesign and implementation of data pipelines and cloud-based architectures for experimentation, model training, validation, and testingIntegration of AI components into automation workflows, digital finance platforms, and microservice-based architecturesRapid prototyping of AI models and contribution to MVP development within Agile teamsContinuous evaluation and optimization of AI performance for accuracy, scalability, and compliance with data privacy and security standardsCollaboration with AI and data engineers to design reusable components, share best practices, and mentor junior team membersWhat You BringUniversity degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or comparable qualifications gained through professional experienceProven experience in developing and deploying AI-based automation solutions in applied business environments, ideally within the Finance domainExpertise in Python, AWS, Snowflake, and AI frameworks for production-grade implementationStrong decision-making skills balancing enterprise architecture, budget, and resource constraints, with experience leading engineering teamsSolid understanding of Agile principles and modern software development practicesCommitment to continuous learning and staying current with state-of-the-art AI advancementsAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the worlds electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character ??? no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
